task2.prompt:
Some people, not including @respirable, believe that practice websites should gently encourage students to manage their time. Others argue that these websites should become petty digital supervisors that notice every suspicious tab switch and judge the user with theatrical disappointment.

Discuss both these views and give your own opinion.
task2.preamble: You should spend about 40 minutes on this task.
